Static original track coordinate; no executed instruction, overlay or CPU address is asserted.

observation: Every raw sector was measured under the selected exact track SHA256. Source1 has 305586 sectors: 196912 Form1 data-declared, 94281 Form1 video-declared, 13562 Form2 audio-declared, 827 Form1 untyped and 4 Form2 untyped. Source2 has 292815: 119829 data-declared, 150486 video-declared, 21604 audio-declared, 892 Form1 untyped and 4 Form2 untyped. Both have 3720 data-sector subheaders 0x89 and one 0x09. Exact header signatures, ranges and marker locations are recorded locally; compact public counts/spans are in coverage/sector-survey.json.
interpretation: XA header flags and end markers provide measured physical inventory leads. They do not by themselves identify a file, video/audio asset, field or minigame, and interleaving makes fine-span counts unsuitable as content counts.

preconditions: Selected reference profiles and verified decoded raw tracks
validation.expected: Exact full-track hash, every sector accounted for, header counts sum to track length, contiguous spans cover the full half-open LBA range.
validation.actual: Both complete scans passed, reproduced the selected raw SHA256 and recorded all XA end-marker LBAs. Original synthetic boundary/truncation/marker tests passed separately.
validation.tolerance: Exact structural counts/hashes; no content identity or playback-timing claim.

limitations: Header flags describe declared sector types, not independently decoded media.
A contiguous header span is not necessarily one resource, audio track or FMV.
Interleaving, padding and reused streams prevent deriving content counts here.
Fields, event IDs, battle/minigame logic and archive tables remain unidentified.
This survey does not verify CD ECC/EDC or original hardware behavior.
author: Phase 0 agent, direct original-data header survey
